editorial.blurb: A beloved mom-and-pop Teochew noodle spot on Argyle serving authentic Cantonese comfort food that tastes like home, run by a no-nonsense old couple who've been perfecting their craft for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early and bring cash—this place closes at 5 pm and doesn't accept cards. Order the mixed dry noodles or Mee Pork Noodle Soup, and ask to add their fried garlic oil to everything; regulars swear by it.
